A '''field guide''' for [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] was once published. It contained information on the latest [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] technology and weapons, and it also recommended [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] for Imperial [[Chef/Legends|chefs]] to try out: namely, [[dianoga pie]], [[Dianogan tea/Legends|dianoga tea]], and [[dewback ribs]].<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|96|Imperial Officers Field Guide}}</ref>
